details.name: Description
details.value:
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing cybersecurity company at the forefront of securing AI-driven software development.

Cycode is redefining how organizations secure software in the age of AI-driven development. Our Agentic Development Security Platform helps enterprises secure the entire software development lifecycle, from prompt to runtime, through AI governance, deep contextual analysis, and autonomous security.

Powered by Cycode AI and Maestro, our orchestration engine, we help organizations identify real risks, prioritize actual exposure, and remediate vulnerabilities at AI speed. Trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises worldwide, Cycode is recognized as a market leader in Application Security, Software Supply Chain Security, and ASPM.

Founded in 2019 and backed by leading investors including Insight Partners and YL Ventures, Cycode is building the future of secure AI-native software development.

As a Backend Developer, you will take part in all stages of development, from architecture and design to deployment and production ownership. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to build scalable, high-quality systems and influence technological and architectural decisions along the way.

Our stack includes .NET Core / C#, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, ArangoDB, Python, Terraform, Docker, and fully CI/CD-driven environments.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 4+ years of experience with microservices development
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture and cloud-native development
  • Experience designing and building asynchronous systems and working with message queues/event-driven architectures
  • Experience with databases
  • Experience in developing a SAAS product

Advantages:

  • Experience in developing a security-related SAAS product.
  • Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
  • B.Sc in Computer Science/Software Engineering or related field
  • Familiarity with the GraphQL framework
  • Familiarity with the Graph Databases

details.name: Description
details.value:
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing cybersecurity company at the forefront of securing AI-driven software development.

Cycode is the leader in agentic development security, with a mission to protect where AI risk is born. Our Agentic Development Security Platform secures the entire software development lifecycle in the age of AI, bringing AI governance, AI code security, software supply chain security, and ASPM together in one connected platform. Powered by Cycode AI and Maestro, our agentic orchestration engine, we help organizations identify real risk, prioritize what matters, and remediate critical vulnerabilities up to 17x faster.

Trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises worldwide, Cycode was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Software Supply Chain Security and in the IDC MarketScape for ASPM. Founded in 2019 and backed by leading investors including Insight Partners and YL Ventures, Cycode is building the future of secure, AI-native software development.

We are looking for a Channel Account Manager (CAM) with a proven track record to join our US sales team and own our channel business across the East region. This role reports to the Head of Global Channels and is a strategic member of the team.

As a CAM, you will build and grow Cycode's partner ecosystem in your territory. You will deepen relationships with our key partners, recruit and activate new ones, and turn them into a meaningful, repeatable source of pipeline and revenue. You will work hand in hand with our regional sales teams to drive joint wins, and you will own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue in your territory.

To be successful in this role, you must bring strong, existing relationships with leading security partners in your region. You should be equally comfortable building executive relationships with partner leadership and working side by side with partner sellers on specific opportunities. This is a builder role: you will have real ownership and a direct impact on how Cycode goes to market through partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the channel business in your territory, including partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced revenue, and quota attainment.
  • Manage and grow relationships with key strategic partners, including GuidePoint Security, Optiv, and Trace3.
  • Recruit and onboard new partners, including VARs, MSSPs, and system integrators, with a focus on partners that can drive meaningful AppSec and DevSecOps business.
  • Build and execute joint business plans with key partners, including targets, account mapping, marketing activities, and enablement milestones.
  • Enable partner sales and technical teams to position, sell, and demo Cycode's platform, including Cycode AI, Maestro, and our agentic workflows.
  • Build strong seller-to-seller relationships between partner reps and Cycode's regional sales teams, and drive collaboration on account planning and joint opportunities.
  • Generate net-new pipeline through partner-led campaigns, events, and joint go-to-market activities.
  • Work closely with Cycode's sales leadership to align on territory strategy, deal registration, and rules of engagement.
  • Run regular business reviews (QBRs) with partners to track performance, address gaps, and identify growth opportunities.
  • Act as the partner's internal voice, sharing feedback with Sales, Marketing, and Product to strengthen Cycode's channel program.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting in Salesforce.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 3+ years of channel sales or partner management experience in cybersecurity
  • Strong existing partner relationships across the East Coast, including GuidePoint Security
  • Strong relationships with Optiv and Trace3
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding channel quota
  • Experience recruiting and activating new partners, not only managing an established program
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and leadership teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both partner executives and individual sellers
  • Self-starter with a high sense of ownership, integrity, and a team-player mindset
  • Willingness to travel within the territory

    Advantages:
  • Experience in Application Security (AppSec), DevSecOps, or cloud security
  • Experience at a growth-stage or mid-sized security vendor
  • Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC
  • Experience with Salesforce and partner relationship management (PRM) tools

  • 5+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer in cloud environment
  • Proven production experience with deploying, running, and operating complex, high-availability, and large-scale web applications on AWS Cloud
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, including different autoscaling strategies
  • Terraform hands-on experience

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing cybersecurity company at the forefront of securing AI-driven software development.

Our Agentic Development Security Platform secures the entire software development lifecycle in the age of AI, bringing AI governance, AI code security, software supply chain security, and ASPM together in one connected platform. We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) with a proven track record to join our Customer Success team. This role reports to the Director of Customer Success and is a strategic member of the team.

As a TAM, you will be the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from mid-sized organizations through Fortune 500 companies. You will own the technical health of each account: guiding deployment and integration across the customer’s development environment, driving adoption of the platform and its AI capabilities, resolving complex technical issues, and turning all of it into measurable security outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you must have hands-on experience in software development, DevOps, and/or cybersecurity. You must be able to explain technology in both technical and non-technical terms. You should be equally comfortable holding strategic conversations with C-level executives and running technical deep dives with engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across different industries.
  • Lead technical onboarding and deployment. Plan and guide the integration of Cycode with customers’ source control, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, ticketing systems, and other tools in their ecosystem to ensure fast time-to-value.
  • Own the technical health of your accounts. Monitor configuration, coverage, and usage, and proactively identify gaps, risks, and optimization opportunities.
  • Act as the technical escalation point for your customers. Troubleshoot complex issues and drive them to resolution together with Support and R&D.
  • Understand each customer’s architecture, security program, pain points, compelling events, and success measures. Build technical success plans that drive adoption, timely renewals, and expansion while minimizing churn.
  • Drive adoption of Cycode AI, Maestro, and agentic workflows. Help customers put AI-driven prioritization and remediation into practice and govern AI usage across their development lifecycle.
  • Run regular technical cadences and business reviews (QBRs, EBRs) with security, engineering, and executive stakeholders to continuously demonstrate value and ROI.
  • Deliver technical enablement and training on how to best administer, configure, and optimize the platform, including policies, workflows, dashboards, and APIs.
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally. Bring product feedback and feature requests to Product and R&D to help improve our platform and services.
  • Proactively educate customers on new features and capabilities added to the Cycode platform.
  • Document each customer’s environment, use cases, configurations, and integrations throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Create advocacy and evangelism opportunities for customers.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years of experience in technical account management, customer success, or another technical customer-facing role with enterprise software
  • 5+ years of experience in the software development and/or cybersecurity industry
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience deploying, integrating, or troubleshooting enterprise software in complex customer environments
  • Familiarity with Application Security (AppSec) concepts, and experience in cybersecurity preferred
  • Familiarity with SCM tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket, as well as CI/CD pipelines and REST APIs
  • Proven project management skills, with experience managing Fortune 500 customers and/or complex technical projects that achieved high customer satisfaction
  • Experience managing a portfolio of at least $3M in ARR
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to both engineers and executives and to build strong, trusted relationships
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address customer needs
  • High integrity, a team player ready to help others, and a self-starter with intellectual curiosity

Advantages

  • Proficiency with modern scripting and programming languages
  • Working proficiency with Kubernetes
  • Experience working with Planhat or a similar Customer Success platform
